experiment: P10 budget-depth structural plans with mean-audited risk
reason_for_new_arm: the original strict arm remains passed only on one of six P8-501 seeds; several positive-mean complete plans were rejected solely by individual scenario losses
objective: test a mean-score decision rule without rewriting the original strict result

search.root_domain: every legal shield and cut without persona, sign, direction, positive-graph, or singleton-ROI prefilter
search.terminal_objective: exact structure end-state score plus bounded mean-response persuasion allocation
search.redundancy_rule: never shield a node after cutting an incident edge; deduplicate identical topologies
search.execution: force the accepted structure prefix only, then return to bounded P9

risk_arms.strict: selection scenarios 0-4 have positive mean and nonnegative minimum; unused audit scenarios 5-12 also have positive mean and nonnegative minimum
risk_arms.mean_audited: selection scenarios 0-4 have positive mean; unused audit scenarios 5-12 also have positive mean; individual scenario losses are permitted and fully reported

reporting: paired mean, minimum, maximum and win/tie/loss by cohort and arm
selection and audit minimums and means
complete searched and executed structure prefixes
planned persuasion allocation and final actual action counts
first divergence, budget, failed actions, expanded states and wall time
exact baseline equality for every rejected plan
decision: zero failed or illegal actions and valid budget/step use
report mean_audited only as development-success if its combined mean versus P9 is positive
do not relabel the prior strict result
do not open confirmation, promote, modify production, or infer an official score
